subject.title: fix(cron): separate command execution status from announce-delivery status

question: Should omitted `delivery.bestEffort` remain the strict compatibility behavior for existing and CLI-created announce jobs, or should OpenClaw deliberately migrate that default to lenient delivery?
rationale: Both options are viable product semantics, but the branch currently changes stored-job and one-shot deletion behavior for users who never opted into best-effort delivery.

options.title: Preserve omitted-value strictness
options.body: Keep omitted `bestEffort` strict and require `bestEffort: true` for lenient execution-success semantics.

options.title: Adopt lenient implicit delivery
options.body: Approve a versioned migration that writes `bestEffort: true` only for the intended new default and documents the changed retry/deletion behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve omitted-value strictness
recommendation.body: Keep omitted `bestEffort` strict and require `bestEffort: true` for lenient execution-success semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron announce-delivery work makes this the best available low-confidence owner signal for the delivery contract.
